key_insight: EurekAgent argues that the main bottleneck in autonomous scientific discovery is no longer just agent prompting or workflows, but the design of the environment that constrains and enables agent behavior.
engineering_relevance: The paper reframes agent system design as environment engineering: tuning permissions, artifacts, budgets, and human oversight to improve reliability, collaboration, and search efficiency.
method: Permissions engineering for bounded execution and isolated evaluation
Artifact engineering using filesystem and Git-based collaboration
Budget and human-in-the-loop engineering for cost-aware exploration and low-friction supervision
evidence_signal: Across mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning benchmarks, EurekAgent reports new state-of-the-art results, including 26-circle packing discovered for under $11 in total API cost.
watch_item: Results may depend on careful environment setup and task-specific constraints, so reproducing the gains could require substantial implementation effort and infrastructure discipline.
paper_title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
